connector.name: Kibana MCP
connector.registryDescription: Kibana/Elasticsearch MCP - log search, aggregations, index discovery, dashboards.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kibana-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mshegolev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ELASTICSEARCH_URL
env.description: Direct Elasticsearch URL. If unset, ES requests route through the Kibana Console proxy.

env.name: KIBANA_API_KEY
env.description: Elasticsearch API key (ApiKey base64(id:api_key) format). Takes priority over Basic auth.

env.name: KIBANA_USERNAME
env.description: HTTP Basic auth username. Used only when KIBANA_API_KEY is not set.

env.name: KIBANA_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Verify SSL certificates (true/false). Set to 'false' for self-signed certs.
